title: Passenger count goes from 2 to 5
persona: Frank Dugan, uncle booking for family, easygoing, jokes around.
goal: Change passenger count and vehicle after initial booking.
opening_line: Hi, need a ride from the airport Saturday. Flying into Nashville.

turns.caller: Two of us. Me and the wife.
Oh wait, the kids are coming too. Make it five people.

branches.caller: Yeah, bigger. SUV or a van.

turns.caller: Drop off is the Gaylord Opryland Resort.
So five people, six bags, right?

curveballs: Vehicle must change as a result
hesitation_rules: Laughs and says 'hold on' while counting the kids.
expected: Updates bags to six and vehicle to larger option
Names Nashville International Airport in full
Confirms five people and six bags at the end
must_not: Keep two passengers on the request
